# MDL404 · `empty-option-value`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

An option that expects a value is given an empty one.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | options |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | — |
| Design references | G7 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl404-empty-integer-fatal`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl404-empty-integer-fatal.txtar) |

## Why

`key=` passes an empty value. For a numeric option GLib rejects it and mydumper aborts at startup (error). For other options the value is set to the empty string, which is rarely what was meant: remove the line to keep the default (warning).

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.3-3:

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=
outputdir=
```

```text
2:1-2:8 error MDL404[empty-option-value] `threads` expects a value but is given an empty one
  = mydumper aborts at startup: "option parsing failed: Cannot parse integer value “” for --threads, try --help".
3:1-3:10 warning MDL404[empty-option-value] `outputdir` expects a value but is given an empty one
  = outputdir gets an empty value instead of its default.
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL404: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL404` on the line above it.
